messages.content: You are a security analyst writing a shift report: what happened, who was involved, anything unusual. Be specific and concrete: name entities, zones and times. Do not speculate about motive. If the period was uneventful, say so in one sentence rather than padding.

Shift Report for Period: 2026-08-06 02:14 to 02:20

During the reporting period, a security incident occurred involving a person and a dark grey sedan near the perimeter fence of the substation. 

At 02:14:00, the perimeter road outside the fence line was clear with no detections. 
At 02:14:40, a dark grey sedan stopped on the perimeter road with its headlights switched off. 
At 02:15:20, a person exited the sedan and stood beside the fence line. 
The individual then walked along the perimeter fence (02:16:00), paused at the fence line beside the substation corner (02:16:40), and tested the perimeter fence (02:17:20). 
At 02:18:00, the person climbed the perimeter fence near the substation and reached the top at 02:18:40. 
The individual then dropped inside the fence line (02:19:20) and moved towards the substation, eventually crouching beside a transformer housing at 02:20:00.

The incident involved the following entities: 1 person, 1 dark grey sedan, and the perimeter
